sampling_frame: Frozen first100 probability sample from 1,500 tasks; not a population census.
blindness: Claude received figures, questions and all options, but not released gold, GPT outcomes, native verifier outcomes or flag reason.

disagreement_review.policy: Only exact specific-option corroboration counts FN. Both judges excluding gold counts FP. All other cases and all 72 unflagged sample tasks count as non-errors.

cluster_caveat: The 100 sampled tasks have 100 distinct task-prefix/paper groups, so the deterministic 100,000-replicate paper-group bootstrap reduces to a task bootstrap; both lower bounds cross 15%.
inference: Neither conservative cross-provider rate is definitively above or below 15%. Do not claim verifier pass or fail from this audit. Continue the frozen accuracy expansion; a definitive accuracy failure can stop qualification without resolving verifier rates.
raw_policy: Detailed secondary outputs remain outside git.
